task: Get a reminder to fill in Ezra's school application, and find out whether the application is actually done or still missing something.
transcript: open: a welcome screen said 'Your AI workforce. Every card is a Claude Code agent in its own terminal... amux is the operations layer around a whole fleet', with Skip and Next.
tap Skip: landed on a dark screen with tabs Workers, Board, Usage, Tasks, Groups, Calendar, Scheduler and 'No workers yet. Tap + to create one.' I did not know what any of it meant.
tap Home: a friendly screen 'What can I help with?' with example prompts and a box, and a promise that nothing is sent without my OK.
type my request in plain words and press enter: a conversation titled 'Track Ezra's school application' opened, saying 'Family admin is on it', showing 'Working on it...'.
wait 30 (x2): still 'Working on it', now '1 min'.
wait 30 (x2): 'Working on it... 2 min. Reading email and calendar can take a few minutes.'

tap Details: 'What it looked at: It answered without opening your email or calendar.' and 'Open the full workspace'. This contradicted the chat, which had not answered anything and claimed to be reading email and calendar.
tap Back and wait 30 (x2): still 'Working on it... 5 min', 6 minutes after asking. No reminder confirmation and no answer about the application. I gave up.
stumbles: The first screen talked about an 'AI workforce', 'Claude Code agent', 'terminal' and 'fleet'. Nothing for a parent.
Skip dropped me on a 'Workers' tab saying 'No workers yet', not on the chat. I had to guess that Home was the place to talk.
After asking, it never answered. 'Working on it' ran past 6 minutes; ChatGPT answers in seconds.
Details said 'It answered without opening your email or calendar' while the chat still said it was reading my email and calendar and had answered nothing. The two screens disagreed.
No reminder was confirmed, so I do not know if I will be reminded at all.
verdict: Once I found the Home chat, asking was as easy as ChatGPT, but after six minutes I had no reminder and no answer about Ezra's application, and the Details page claimed it had already answered. The welcome screen and the Workers tab I landed on after Skip would have lost me before I ever reached the chat if I had not guessed Home.
